meta.name: sow-pws-builder
meta.description: Build Statements of Work (SOW) or Performance Work Statements (PWS) for federal contracts through a structured scope decision workflow that produces a contract-file-ready .docx and a separate chat-only staffing handoff table for the IGCE Builder. Use this skill whenever the user asks to write a SOW, PWS, statement of work, performance work statement, convert a SOO to a SOW/PWS, develop requirements, define contract scope, build a work statement, or draft requirement language. Also trigger when the user says they need a SOW/PWS before building an IGCE, when they have a SOO and need to develop it into executable requirements, or when they need to reduce scope to fit a budget. The SOW/PWS document NEVER contains staffing tables, FTE counts, labor category counts, or IGCE-related content; that data lives in a separate chat-output handoff for the IGCE Builder skills (FFP, LH/T&M, CR). Do NOT use for IGCEs themselves (use IGCE Builder skills). Do NOT use for market research reports.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将需求转化为联邦合同就绪的SOW/PWS文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为联邦合同编写或转换SOW/PWS文档。
copy.tagline_en: Turn requirements into contract-ready SOW/PWS documents
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to write or convert SOW/PWS documents for federal contracts.

howto.what: Claude 会引导你完成一系列结构化决策，生成一份符合联邦合同要求的 SOW 或 PWS 文档（.docx 格式），并在对话中输出一份供 IGCE Builder 使用的人员配置交接表。
howto.when: 当你要求编写 SOW、PWS、将 SOO 转换为 SOW/PWS、开发需求、定义合同范围、构建工作说明或起草需求语言时触发。也适用于需要缩减范围以匹配预算的情况。

say.text: 帮我写一份 PWS，用于 IT 支持服务。
say.note: 启动完整构建流程，Claude 会询问合同类型等关键信息。

say.text: 把这个 SOO 转换成 SOW。
现有 SOW 超出预算，帮我缩减范围。
say.note: 启动范围缩减流程，Claude 会引导你决定削减哪些内容。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you through structured decisions to produce a contract-file-ready SOW or PWS (.docx) and a chat-only staffing handoff table for the IGCE Builder.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to write a SOW/PWS, convert a SOO to SOW/PWS, develop requirements, define contract scope, build a work statement, or reduce scope to fit a budget.

say_en.text: Write a PWS for IT support services.
say_en.note: Starts full build; Claude asks contract type etc.

say_en.text: Convert this SOO into a SOW.
say_en.note: Starts SOO conversion; Claude extracts and fills gaps.

say_en.text: My SOW exceeds budget; help me descope.
say_en.note: Starts scope reduction; Claude guides cuts.
